segments.narration: Ten reviews is the first algorithm threshold for local ranking. There's no universal magic number.
You need at least 10 reviews to see a measurable local ranking lift.
You need 20 reviews before most consumers trust you enough to call.
And you need new reviews coming in every 90 days, or Google's algorithm treats your profile like a ghost town.
A Sterling Sky case study tested three local businesses in 2025 and found a clear ranking lift once each one crossed 10 reviews.
They think they need 50 or 100 reviews before Google takes them seriously.
Once you're past 10, volume relative to your competitors becomes the signal that matters.
